fluff_intro.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_intro.text: Well, well. If it isn't young Patch. You've lost something, lad.

fluff_intro.speaker: patch
fluff_intro.text: My tail? Oh, that. I lost it wrestling a thunderstorm. Two thunderstorms, actually. They were twins.

fluff_intro.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_intro.text: Mm-hm. I was on the Weather Page that night, you know. I saw what I saw.

fluff_intro.speaker: patch
fluff_intro.text: Ha! Ha. Anyway! Why is everything so... squelchy?

fluff_intro.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_intro.text: The Sogg. It's unfolding the meadow, one hill at a time. The windmills have stopped, and my flock is swelling up like sponges.

fluff_intro.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_intro.text: Pull the tabs, lad. The book still remembers how it's meant to fold. Up ahead, the old platform tab should still work.

fluff_intro.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_intro.text: And if you're heading for the Windmill Hills... three of my flock wandered off up there. Soaked through and grumpy. Shoo them home for me?

fluff_intro.speaker: patch
fluff_intro.text: Herding sheep? For a legend like me? ...Fine. But I'm telling everyone it was dangerous.

fluff_repeat.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_repeat.text: Mind the Soggies. A good swipe dries them right out.

fluff_repeat.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_repeat.text: And Patch? Whatever happened that night, nobody here thinks less of you.

dot_meet.speaker: dot
dot_meet.text: Hello. I am Dot. I end sentences.

dot_meet.speaker: dot
dot_meet.text: Was. My sentence got smeared. Now I just float. Badly.

dot_meet.speaker: patch
dot_meet.text: Well, you're in luck! You've found the bravest fox in all of Foldwick.

dot_meet.speaker: dot
dot_meet.text: Hm. Fine. I will come. Somebody has to end your sentences.

fluff_quest_progress.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_quest_progress.text: Any luck with my flock? They'll be up on the Windmill Hills, sulking somewhere high and damp.

fluff_quest_done.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_quest_done.text: All three home, and only a little mildewed! You've a kind heart under all that bragging, Patch.

fluff_quest_done.speaker: patch
fluff_quest_done.text: It was nothing. Well. It was three things. Fluffy things.

fluff_quest_done.speaker: shepherd_fluff
fluff_quest_done.text: Here, take these Scraps. And lad? Whatever happened to your tail, it's still you walking about without it.

windmill_hills_arrival.speaker: patch
windmill_hills_arrival.text: Because they're soggy. Everything's soggy. Even my jokes are soggy, and my jokes are excellent.

millwheel_arrival.speaker: patch
millwheel_arrival.text: That's the old mill. It used to grind sunshine into flour for the whole meadow.

millwheel_arrival.speaker: patch
millwheel_arrival.text: Windmills don't look at people, Dot. They don't have... oh. Oh, it has eyes.
